title: Plain format readers for the structured template and the runner recompile
summary: verifyStructuredTemplate reads a template under the plain structured-template name with formatVersion 1 as well as under the original ia.structured-template.v1 literal, preserving the stamp it was written with. The runner rebuilds a retained compiled harness under the stamp it carries, so a harness compiled before formats stopped carrying a version still verifies against its capture.
